lead_raw_text:
The structure of CoMoN₂ crystallizes in the monoclinic space group P2/m (No. 15), with a unit cell containing four atoms and four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Co centers coordinated by three N neighbors, Mo centers by two N neighbors, and N centers in environments with two Co neighbors or one Co and one Mo neighbor. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single two-dimensional component spanning all four sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations indicate corner- and edge-sharing between the 3-vertex Co polyhedra.
